abstract: Migration from bridge-based SQLite and SQL-style Capacitor plugins (@capacitor-community/sqlite, cordova-sqlite-storage, ORM drivers) to @capgo/capacitor-fast-sql: inventory, API mapping table, iOS ATS local networking and Android localhost cleartext setup, SQLCipher encryption, web OPFS headers, data carry-over options that preserve existing database files, cleanup, verification, and exact error fixes.
